notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a governmental fund here), so business_type is null. Receipts/disbursements from Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds column (amounts on p5, labels on p4). Debt proceeds 190,000 is printed inside Total Receipts 14,435,105.49, so it is in debt_proceeds and reported total includes debt_proceeds. 'Taxes: Other' 2,852,808.09 split using the General Fund budget schedule (p8: homestead, property tax credit, pro-rate, carline) plus Special Building pro rate 208.32 (p16); homestead/credit/pro-rate recorded as intergovernmental/state aid. 'Other student support' split into Activities (837,892.61) and School Nutrition (571,928.24) disbursements; 'Debt Service' split into principal and interest from the Special Building Fund (p16). Transfer of 250,000 General to Depreciation Fund is eliminated in Exhibit D (nets out); top-level transfers null. Exhibit E (p6-7) is a General Fund components schedule showing the transfer and reclassifications (150,000 transportation, 100,000 facilities); Exhibit G budget schedule (General incl. Depreciation transfers) still carries those amounts inside spending (4700 Building improvements 100,000 = whole facilities reclass; transportation group lines 2710-2733 hold 150,000, line unknown), so contra lines and an other-financing -250,000 are recorded in detail and the General Fund expenditure total (11,414,634.70) is flagged includes other financing. Exhibit E itself not recorded in detail to avoid double counting. General Fund detail: Exhibit N (program x object, p18-25; the v8 re-trim added report pp37-42, so it is now complete through Total Cash Disbursements 11,414,634.69 on p25) replaces every program line of the Exhibit G budget schedule, so nothing is double counted; only the two transfer contra lines and the -250,000 other-financing line stay under Exhibit G, whose expenditure total (p10, 11,414,634.70, equal to the sum of the Exhibit N lines; Exhibit N itself prints Total Cash Disbursements 11,414,634.69, a 0.01 rounding difference in the report) counts the Exhibit N lines via includes_schedules. The hidden transfers are now identified: Exhibit N Vehicle Operation Capital Assets 150,000.00 (p24) and Building Improvements Capital Assets 100,000.00 (p25). Exhibit N object mapping: Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance; Other Expenses -> dues, training and travel; Other/Purchased Professional Services -> professional/contract services; Capital Assets -> equipment purchases (Building Improvements -> construction/infrastructure). Revenue lines with zero actual in Exhibit G (e.g. 1990, 1925, 4525, 4530, 5320) were skipped. Bond Fund (Ex. K) had no activity. Activities Fund receipts have no revenue breakdown (shown as student activity receipts, charges for services). Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p1), no liabilities printed. Read pages 1-25 of 25

report_discrepancies.note: Exhibit N prints total disbursements 11,414,634.69; its lines (and the Ex. G total, p10) add to 11,414,634.70 (rounding in the report)

Should part of the activity receipts in detail be treated as donations rather than charges for services?
